_note: check_write_capability / checkWriteCapability over (vfs, policy, mode, backend, caches): expect is the refusal message, null when the mount comes up. The order of the arms is the contract the multi-fault rows pin.

cases.name: conditional on minio (put and create only)
staged is refused
cases.expect: mount '/x/': write: staged needs a staging layer, and mirage has none; use conditional or unconditional

cases.name: conditional on a read-only mount
cases.expect: mount '/x/': write: conditional needs a writable mount; this one is read

cases.name: conditional with backend fuse
cases.expect: mount '/x/': write: conditional cannot be exposed through backend fuse, which has no place to carry the version

cases.name: conditional with backend fskit
cases.expect: mount '/x/': write: conditional cannot be exposed through backend fskit, which has no place to carry the version

cases.name: conditional on a backend with no condition
cases.expect: mount '/x/': write: conditional needs a backend that refuses a stale write; gridfs does not

cases.name: conditional on a mount that caches nothing
cases.expect: mount '/x/': write: conditional needs a mount that caches reads; the version a write sends is the one its cached copy holds

cases.name: several faults: staged is named first
cases.expect: mount '/x/': write: staged needs a staging layer, and mirage has none; use conditional or unconditional

cases.name: several faults: read-only before the backend
cases.expect: mount '/x/': write: conditional needs a writable mount; this one is read

cases.name: several faults: the backend before the conditions
cases.expect: mount '/x/': write: conditional cannot be exposed through backend fuse, which has no place to carry the version

cases.name: several faults: the conditions before the cache
cases.expect: mount '/x/': write: conditional needs a backend that refuses a stale write; gridfs does not
